metadata.case_name: HUNG CHI WAH v. YAU KA LUN ALAN AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: running his own business of driving a van to deliver goods for others

injuries.description: Rupture of the left brachial artery
source: At the time of the accident he sustained a rupture of the left brachial artery.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified blood vessels at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: Laceration of left arm (left forearm) with surgical scar
source: As a result of the traffic accident the Plaintiff suffered multiple injuries: a laceration of his left arm and a laceration of his left ear.
The left elbow wound was explored for the cause of the profuse bleeding. It left a surgical scar in the left forearm.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of forearm

source: As a result of the traffic accident the Plaintiff suffered multiple injuries: a laceration of his left arm and a laceration of his left ear.
The left ear laceration was sutured.

manifestations.description: Pain over the scar on exertion
Surgical scar in the left forearm
Range of motion of his left elbow was almost fully recovered (reduced range earlier)
Suffers 3% impairment of the whole person
May have slight decrease in efficiency in his work productivity when he has to carry heavy load with his arms

source: The left elbow wound was explored for the cause of the profuse bleeding.

treatments_received.treatment: Repair of torn left brachial artery by resection of the damaged part of the artery
source: Repair operation was performed on torn left brachial artery by resection of the damaged part of the artery.
The left ear laceration was sutured.

treatments_received.treatment: Long arm back slab application and removal
source: A long arm back slab was put on to protect the repaired artery and the repaired muscles.
The long arm slab was removed on 2.7.2005.
Since then he attended follow-up and physiotherapy treatment.

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities arising from the injuries to left arm (including surgical scar) and left ear

comparable_cases.case_name: Ngai Lung Hing v. Gowin Engineering Co. Ltd. & anor.
comparable_cases.injury_description: Deep cut to right forearm with muscle bulk injuries; suturing of muscle bulk; stiffness of the wrist and muscle injury; assessed total 10% impairment of the whole person; discharged 3 days later; attended 9 sessions of outpatient physiotherapy and 26 sessions of occupational therapy.
